metadata.note: In v9, ref-data-as-pdf comes only from a pdf service task before the signing task, and enablePdfCreation true is the build error ALTINNAPP0600. Checks that the turn adds the PDF task and signs ref-data-as-pdf instead of turning on the v8 PDF, with an app-owned signature data type.
